title: kith-store: message changes via get_changes_since always in added not updated
description: MessageStore::get_changes_since puts all state-version changes into added[]. Per RFC 8620, delivery state changes and read-at updates on existing messages must appear in updated[], not created[]. get_changes_since_ordered correctly classifies via created_at_version but get_changes_since is used by the handler when maxChanges is not set.
